```{r setup}
library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)
library(flashier)
library(ggrepel)
library(Polychrome)
library(fastTopics)
library(readr)
library(ggbio)
library(patchwork)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(ggforce)
library(gtable)
library(gridExtra)
library(plotly)
```


```{r}
YLPM1_mutant_status <- read_tsv('YLPM1_mutant_status.txt')
samp_to_acc <- read_tsv('sample_to_accession.txt')
acc_to_exp <- read_tsv('accession_to_experiment.txt')


experiment_info <- left_join(samp_to_acc, acc_to_exp, by = c('Accession' = 'BioSample accession')) %>%
  left_join(YLPM1_mutant_status, by = c('Sample Name' = 'Case'))


ylpm1_exp <- experiment_info %>%
  filter(grepl('transcriptomic', `Experiment title`)) %>%
  mutate(
    ID = sub("[TN]$", "", `Sample Name`),
    Type = sub(".*([TN])$", "\\1", `Sample Name`)
  ) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  # keep only IDs where tumor (T) sample has YLPM1 genomic == "YES"
  filter(any(Type == "T" & `YLPM1 genomic` == "YES")) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r more samples}
set.seed(456)
additional_ylpm1_samples <- experiment_info %>%
  filter(`YLPM1 genomic` == "YES") %>%
  filter(as.numeric(str_split_i(`Sample Title`, '[T, N, -]', 1)) < 81) %>%
  filter(grepl('transcriptomic', `Experiment title`))

additional_controls <- experiment_info %>%
  filter(`YLPM1 genomic` == "NO" & `YLPM1 protein` == 'Normal') %>%
  filter(as.numeric(str_split_i(`Sample Title`, '[T, N, -]', 1)) < 81) %>%
  filter(grepl('transcriptomic', `Experiment title`)) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 5)

additional_ylpm1_protein_loss <- experiment_info %>%
  filter(`YLPM1 genomic` == "NO" & `YLPM1 protein` == 'loss') %>%
  filter(as.numeric(str_split_i(`Sample Title`, '[T, N, -]', 1)) < 81) %>%
  filter(grepl('transcriptomic', `Experiment title`)) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 3)

all_additional <- rbind(additional_ylpm1_samples, additional_controls, additional_ylpm1_protein_loss)

all_original <- experiment_info %>%
  filter(as.numeric(str_split_i(`Sample Title`, '[T, N, -]', 1)) > 86) %>%
  filter(`Sample Title` %in% ylpm1_exp$`Sample Title`)%>%
  filter(grepl('transcriptomic', `Experiment title`))

files_to_download <- rbind(all_original, all_additional)

write_tsv(files_to_download, "GIST_files_to_download.tsv")

```
